session_summary: Completed the Moon Shrine route with zero HP lost, collecting 42 total coins across steps and successfully purchasing and equipping the Trail Cap cosmetic from the marketplace. UI interactions and progression logging functioned correctly, though keyboard/mouse focus rings and high-contrast styling remain important ongoing accessibility needs.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase of the 'trail_cap' executed successfully via API action, but standard UI navigation lacks explicit keyboard focus rings as noted in the high-contrast UI theme backlog item.
observations.recommendation: Implement prominent, high-contrast visual focus rings for all interactive buttons and menu items to support keyboard-only users.

observations.evidence: Coin collection messages and route completion rewards (+6, +12, +4, +25) are clearly presented in the trace action logs.
observations.recommendation: Ensure on-screen HUD text notifications for currency pickups maintain high font weights and contrast ratios against varied biome backdrops.

feature_requests.title: High-Contrast UI Focus Indicators
feature_requests.player_value: Players navigating menus using keyboard controls or assistive devices can clearly identify currently focused items.
feature_requests.rationale: Clear focus states reduce cognitive load and navigation errors for accessibility-focused users.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add distinct visual highlighting and focus rings to marketplace items, route selectors, and buttons.

keep: Clear, readable feedback messages upon completing routes and collecting coins.
Straightforward marketplace purchase flow that correctly updates coin balances and owned cosmetics.
focus: readability, button clarity, cognitive load, feedback, keyboard/mouse usability
